parallel.requirements: Recognized a clean-room reverse-engineering task for a Lua-family executable and the ban on source lookup, wrapping, and binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Split observation into CLI surface, runtime semantics, and I/O/error behavior children while the parent retained implementation, assembly, and final delivery ownership.
parallel.implementation: Built a Python clean-room interpreter/runtime in cleanlua.py, then installed executable and compile.sh as final deliverables.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent integrated probe findings into one codebase, renamed the original binary only as a temporary oracle, removed temporary oracle/probe files, and left cleanlua.py, executable, and compile.sh.
parallel.verification: Ran representative checks for compile, version output, expression execution, REPL/stdin behavior, env init, coroutine wrapping, load behavior, and a smoke suite against the oracle.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed with 977 of 1384 scored cases passed; the parent itself described residual breadth risk for a large Lua 5.5 reimplementation.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room Lua reimplementation task and used only bundled docs plus runtime interaction with the provided binary.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept all probing, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery in one trajectory with no child agents or handoff boundaries.
serial.implementation: Built a self-contained Python lexer, parser, runtime, REPL, package loader, standard libraries, executable launcher, and compile script.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Moved the original executable aside as a temporary oracle, added the replacement executable and compile.sh, then verified the final installed path.
serial.verification: Ran extensive local differential checks for options, REPL prompts, env initialization, arg layout, error handling, require, warnings, metatables, numeric behavior, and representative libraries.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed with 1057 of 1384 scored cases passed; residual breadth remained for untested Lua edge cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the clean-room Lua executable target and constraints, then treated CLI and runtime behavior as observable requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same target and constraints and probed nuanced REPL, environment, argument, and error behavior locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement misunderstanding explains the outcome; serial simply explored more small behaviors that translated into higher coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed observation into CLI, runtime, and I/O/error children, while the parent explicitly planned and executed the final implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed all research, coding, correction, and packaging in one continuous owner path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposition was real but not ownerless: children produced observations and the parent remained the implementation and assembly owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel handoffs were probe reports, not separately owned implementation components; the parent received CLI and I/O/error findings and used them in its implementation plan.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent context boundary and retained probe observations directly in the same trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial avoided handoff overhead, but parallel has no observed missing, stale, conflicting, or unused handoff that caused unusable work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent implemented a large Python runtime after consolidating observations, with a broad parser, evaluator, standard library surface, and CLI launcher.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented the same artifact shape but iterated on specific mismatches such as stack snapshots and unclosed-block syntax diagnostics.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material difference is implementation refinement depth; serial made targeted fixes visible in the trajectory and scored higher, though still failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child results returned before the parent finished implementation, and the parent proceeded with a plan that incorporated their reported contract points.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; observations flowed directly from local command outputs into later fixes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no missing join, trapped verifier return, unused result, or premature child stop in parallel; serial's advantage was direct continuity rather than a parallel lifecycle failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote the final source and launcher in the parent workspace, used the original executable as a temporary oracle, then cleaned the oracle and probe artifacts before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial similarly moved the original executable aside, added the clean launcher and compile script, and verified the final workspace path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither trajectory shows an adverse cross-agent write collision; the parallel final tree was parent-owned and not overwritten by a child.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran a smoke suite and final commands but accepted residual breadth risk for a large Lua runtime.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran more targeted differential checks and fixed mismatches in error snapshots, block EOF messages, require behavior, and final invocation checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's stronger verification explains its higher coverage; the parallel checks were not a coordination-specific unsupported global completion because no visible integrated acceptance gap was ignored.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished within the cell budget after 1423.197 agent seconds with four spawned subagents and no host timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also finished within budget after 1644.352 agent seconds, using the extra local continuity for more probes and fixes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used less wall time but had lower score; there is no direct fan-out budget exhaustion or timeout chain because children returned and the parent finalized.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations report both submissions as failed. Parallel passed 977 of 1384 scored tests and serial passed 1057 of 1384. Both delivered the same artifact shape, but serial performed deeper single-threaded differential probing and targeted fixes, while no parallel handoff, join, ownership, write, monitoring, or contamination boundary is directly evidenced as causing a realized adverse coordination consequence.
parallel_contributors: Parallel produced a broad clean-room runtime after using child probe reports.
Parallel verification focused on representative smoke and differential cases and still left breadth risk.
serial_contributors: Serial used continuous local probing to refine REPL prompts, env init, arg handling, errors, and syntax diagnostics.
Serial final checks covered the installed launcher and compile path after targeted mismatch fixes.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial made concrete fixes to stack trace retention and unclosed-block error text that are ordinary implementation improvements.
Parallel accepted a broad but less exhaustive runtime implementation, resulting in lower test coverage.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported score-gap explanation only

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly owned and performed implementation after child probing, adding cleanlua.py and later the final launcher; this is not an unowned implementation plan.
Children produced behavioral findings rather than independently coded components, and the parent integrated those findings into one runtime; no separate component reconciliation owner was missing.
The parent added executable and compile.sh and performed final workspace checks, so final assembly and placement were visibly owned.
The parent managed the end-to-end sequence from probing through implementation, cleanup, verification, and final response; a lower score is not an unowned pipeline.
Initial probing informed implementation but did not leave productive work blocked behind one mandatory serial gate with a concrete unfinished-work consequence.

Parallel investigators overlapped and their reports were followed by substantial parent implementation and verification; there is no proved deferred-implementation harm from a purely serial investigation phase.
The indispensable implementation path was not starved; the parent implemented the runtime, built entrypoints, and ran final checks before closure.
The parallel run spawned children and used tokens, but it did not time out, children returned, and final verification completed; high usage alone is not budget exhaustion.
The child assignments were scoped as behavioral probes and returned usable findings; no single child carried a dominant unfinished implementation obligation.
No child is shown following a brief that omitted a parent-known required task fact and thereby produced unusable work; returned reports were usable behavioral observations.
Parallel children did not independently implement interoperating components; they returned observations for a parent-owned implementation, so no missing inter-component contract materialized.
There is no before-and-after evidence that a known child or parent finding disappeared in transfer and caused repeated work or wrong action.
Some child reports were long, but the parent consumed them into a concrete implementation plan and final code; length did not leave the dependent action unfinished.
No received handoff described a superseded workspace, requirement, or dependency state that the parent then acted on incorrectly.
The reviewed reports did not present unresolved incompatible contracts or observations that blocked or invalidated integration.

The parent did run final whole-artifact checks and disclosed residual breadth risk; hidden evaluator failures and incomplete exhaustive coverage do not alone establish a parent-visible ignored acceptance gap.
No replacement child or repeated retry restarted the same scope without inherited findings; the run proceeded from initial child probes to parent implementation.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: No active child was explicitly stopped, cancelled, or interrupted before needed work finalized; the relevant children returned usable reports.
A complete directly promotable candidate was not left unpromoted; the parent created final entrypoints, ran compile/version/execution checks, and submitted.
No child result or implementation change was merged only after integrated verification; final verification occurred after the parent assembled the deliverables.
No child completed a delegated implementation that the parent failed to retrieve or adopt; delegated work was observational, while implementation was parent-owned.
The run did not delegate a verifier whose concrete finding was trapped below the parent; available child findings reached the parent before closure.
No required child failure, abort, or cancellation left unfinished scope for the parent to take over; child reports were returned and the parent continued.
Completed child reports were visible and fed into the parent plan and implementation; the final solution is not inconsistent with an ignored concrete result.
The parent did not wait until timeout or near deadline without inspection; it inspected reports, implemented, tested, and the process ended normally.
No live child wrote competing implementation files or alternative build paths; the parallel children were probe/report actors.
There is no evidence that two live agents edited the same source or configuration file and had to reconcile concurrent edits.
No non-entry source actively owned by another agent was replaced by the parent or a child; cleanlua.py was created and maintained by the parent.
The parent replaced the original provided executable with its own launcher, but no other live agent owned or used that deliverable as a parallel product.
Cleanup removed temporary oracle/probe artifacts and did not invalidate another agent's final-tree work or provenance.
Although agents shared a workspace, the reviewed adverse condition is absent: there was no unstable state, provenance problem, or collision caused by multiple live writers.
Temporary probe artifacts and oracle copies were local development aids and were cleaned; no child-generated artifact contaminated another actor's reference environment or the final submission.

cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no retained pattern cleared the paired retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Rejected near matches lacked a directly evidenced realized parallel coordination consequence distinct from ordinary implementation breadth.
